evidence.title: GitHub - exo-explore/exo: Run frontier AI locally.

name: exo
summary: Connects your devices into an AI cluster to run frontier models locally, with RDMA over Thunderbolt and a chat dashboard.
description: Runs frontier AI models locally across a cluster of your devices: automatic device discovery, RDMA over Thunderbolt 5, topology-aware auto parallel, tensor parallelism and an MLX inference backend. Includes a built-in dashboard for managing the cluster and chatting with models, API compatibility with OpenAI Chat Completions, Claude Messages, OpenAI Responses and Ollama endpoints, custom model loading from HuggingFace, and a background macOS app.
contains: runs models across multiple devices as a cluster
tensor parallelism: 1.8x speedup on 2 devices, 3.2x on 4
dashboard for cluster management and model chat
API-compatible with OpenAI, Claude Messages, OpenAI Responses and Ollama
runs from source on macOS/Linux; macOS app available
